policy.physicalCreation: Create the Europe continent and region indexes first. Country parents and child repositories remain planned until maintainers and datasets are ready.
policy.ownerRequirement: Create repositories only while authenticated as the target owner or an organization admin. Do not let GitHub CLI fall back to the current personal account.
policy.noRawAddress: Do not store raw personal addresses, recipient records, private coordinates, witness data, or private keys in public repositories.
policy.overseasBoundary: European country plans may reference overseas-linked territories, but each territory must keep explicit source, license, canonical region, and display policy.
policy.disputedBoundary: Treat disputed or special regions as technical address identifiers with explicit display policy, not as political recognition.
policy.heavyData: Keep building polygons, coordinates, search indexes, tiles, OSM/Overture extracts, hydrographic data, and generated caches in external content-addressed packs.
